verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs such as llms.txt are a fair question for any public web service, including a state commission's filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation. Instead, both www.scc.virginia.gov and cis.scc.virginia.gov serve robots.txt with "Disallow: /" for all agents, the opposite of inviting agents in. Virginia Tax's named GPTBot ban is a different agency's site and was not weighed.
